name: cure-ind-stacks
note: L10 R3 stack props at the real game camera: the container stack (prop.cure-container-stack) and the drum stack (prop.cure-drum-stack) with the courier between them. Run with --matrix (high/low tier, zoom 1 and 0.5). Look for: corrugation ribs and the rotated top container resting on the lower two, door ends and lock rods, drums standing on the pallets, pallets on the ground, sunk or floating parts, flicker, missing parts at the low tier (LOD2).
